I'd like to go over any corrections, preferences, or practical details you have in mind so I can incorporate them before publishing. Are there any records, photos, or stories you've noticed that might need a second look — especially ones that might be based on family recollections rather than original documents? I want to make sure everything is as accurate as possible before it goes live.
